column1: # §4.7 / PLAN — F9 recalc on a workbook above the cell-count
# threshold routes through the WAIT path so the UI doesn't freeze
# on big sheets. Below the threshold F9 stays synchronous (no
# tokio round-trip). This transcript drops the threshold to 0 so
# any populated workbook exercises the async path.
SIZE 100 25
# Lower the recalc-WAIT threshold so a 1-cell sheet trips it.
RECALC_WAIT_THRESHOLD  0
# Seed A1 with a constant so cells.len() > 0.
KEYS 42
ENTER
ASSERT_CELL      A:A1  42
# Park the next async op so the transcript can observe pre-spawn
# WAIT state.
BLOCK_NEXT_OP
# F9 — explicit recalc. Queues the async op and returns immediately.
F  9
# Mid-flight: WAIT indicator visible, line 3 is the verb-only
# "Recalculating…" line (recalc has no progress to report).
ASSERT_MODE      WAIT
ASSERT_PANEL_L3  Recalculating
# Drain the parked op to completion.
RESUME_OP
# Mode pops back to READY and the cell value survived the recalc.
ASSERT_MODE      READY
ASSERT_CELL      A:A1  42
